themes.text:
<!-- Theme: Minimal (IPOD/THEME 0, docs/ipod.md#display-settings). Its numbers (Home rows, the settings
     top, the progress bar, the scheme colours) come from patch/offsets.inc via tools/theme.py ROLE_MACROS. -->
<theme format="1" id="minimal" name="Minimal" index="0">
  <colorSchemes accents="graphite crimson tidal champagne cobalt tangerine plum ivory green"/>
  <colorScheme name="crimson" raw_red="1"/>  <!-- stock's own reds: the identity -->
  <colorScheme name="ivory" card="1"/>       <!-- the off-white card with dark ink -->
  <!-- The bar's look alone, in every theme: Theme follows the theme, the rest paint that theme's fill, battery and play
       icon in this theme's row. The row itself is the set's, so it needs no restart. Choosing a theme goes back to Theme. -->
  <option key="STATUSBAR" label="Status Bar" default="Theme" preset="Theme"><value label="Theme"/><value label="Minimal"/><value label="Modern"/><value label="Classic"/></option>
  <option setting="time_title" preset="on"/>
  <option key="SHOWQ2POD" label="Show Wordmark" default="On"><value label="Off"/><value label="On"/></option>
  <option setting="light" preset="off" keep="auto"/>
  <option setting="accent" key="MINIMAL_ACCENT" default="graphite" preset="graphite"/>
  <option setting="corners" preset="round"/>
  <option setting="home" preset="split"/>
  <option setting="shortcut"/>
  <option setting="battery"/>
  <option setting="np_layout"/>
  <view name="bar"><element name="title" caps="1"/></view>
  <view name="list">
    <element name="selection" painter="card"/>
    <element name="icons" mono="1" badge_muted="1" addon_mono="1"/>
  </view>
  <view name="home"><element name="chevron" visible="0"/><element name="rows" caps="1"/></view>
  <view name="playing" layout="ipod">
    <element name="art" square="0"/>
    <element name="title" font="regular"/>
    <element name="album" caps="1" opacity="0"/>
    <element name="state" opacity="0"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Cover Flow's shelf: where the side covers stand is the iPod preset of #329's Cover Flow Parameter Lab, its
       units times 0.16 (docs/internals.md#coverflow-depth), every theme's; the rest takes CF_* (ROLE_MACROS). At speed
       (arch_at to arch_full albums/s, Fast Navigation off) the covers within arch_span of the middle bend into the
       lab's arch, forming over arch_in ms and relaxing over arch_out, the covers following the wheel by arch_tau ms.
       The thumb is every theme's, Classic's and Modern's by extends:
       the wheel holds the covers (docs/internals.md#coverflow-thumb); these are its numbers, to retune on the wheel.
       A spin goes by letters, one each jump_ticks of travel (0: never). With Fast Navigation off, after jump_ms at
       jump_at ticks/s or more, they are named on the moving row, jump_pace apart, until the thumb slows or turns
       back; on, after big_jump_ms at big_jump_at, a faster spin as a false start costs more, they last until the
       thumb lifts: the row comes in over enter_albums, slides from letter to letter (slide_ms) and folds out once
       within fold_near of the letter. -->
  <view name="coverflow">
    <element name="shelf" eye="256" tilt="90" x1="128" xs="35" z1="77" zs="0" horizon="64" swing="2"
             arch_at="8" arch_full="16" arch_span="500" arch_in="100" arch_out="62" arch_tau="56"
             thumb="1" ticks_turn="36" ticks_album="7" fast_at="23" fast_full="90" top_speed="20" track="30"
             snap="25" spin="130" far_left="250" detent="80" hold_ms="5000" stop_ms="60" stop_left="60" rate_up="120"
             rate_down="50" back="50" dead="1" contact_ms="40" aim_snap="30" lead_from="25" lead_full="100" lead_ms="45"
             row_shift="20" row_from="100" row_full="300" row_shrink="8" row_flat="200" row_out="33" row_edge="160"
             row_width="40" row_key="72" jump_ms="700" jump_ticks="5" jump_at="32" jump_pace="140"
             big_jump_at="75" big_jump_ms="240" enter_albums="8" slide_ms="160" fold_near="50"/>
  </view>
</theme>

themes.text:
<!-- Theme: Classic (IPOD/THEME 1, docs/ipod.md#display-settings): a light iPod look, with a dark half, on its own
     geometry sets, declared below. Its numbers are this file's, but for what ROLE_MACROS (tools/theme.py) and Minimal supply. Its id, classic-light,
     names its art, sets and face (classic_light_*, classic-light*). -->
<theme format="1" id="classic-light" name="Classic" index="1" extends="minimal">
  <!-- Classic's geometry sets: a 26 px bar over a 294 px window, 32 px rows, nine of them filling it (4 px above and
       below a 24 px line box). The Library is always 32 px text.
       classic-light (Row Art on) has 52 px album rows with the stock art drawn 1:1; classic-light-text (Row Art off)
       makes those lists 32 px and has no artwork. Songs are two lines at 52 px under both. classic-light states every field, so the built-in set's defaults never reach Classic. Text
       y centres stock's 24, 20 and 16 px label boxes in a 32 px row (AWTK centres the text in its
       box); 52 px art rows centre their two lines. list_end is eight rows: a ninth row's text would sit under the glass. -->
  <geometry name="classic-light" bar="26" pitch="32" body="32" art="52" art_inset="0" art_pitch="52"
            art_body="52" text_art="0" text_art_inset="0" lib_pitch="32" lib_body="32" lib_inset="0"
            lib_art="0" title24_y="4" title_y="6" meta_y="8"
            count_y="8" art_title24_y="1" art_meta_y="29" song_pitch="52" song_body="52" song_title24_y="1"
            song_meta_y="29" set_row="32" set_top="0" set_rows="9"
            set_icon="0" stream_row="52" bar_px="21" bar_title_w="91" bar_right="60" batt_w="26" batt_h="13" text_x="20" list_end="256" action_row="32" home_row="32" home_lib="1" np_ipod="1"
            stock_row="32" stock_body="32" stock_title_y="0" stock_title_h="32" toolbar="0"
            search_row="52" search_body="52" search_art="0" search_title_y="1" search_title24_y="1" search_title_h="28"
            search_meta_y="29" search_meta_h="20"/>
  <!-- Stock's own list pages (Lock Screen, Update Library, More, Queue, Go to, Special Folders) take the set's rows: stock_row and the two
       after it; 78, 70, 11 and 20 give back stock's. toolbar 0 hides their toolbars but for Go to's and Special Folders', and the Sleep Timer's. -->
  <geometry name="classic-light-text" extends="classic-light" art="0" art_pitch="32" art_body="32" art_title24_y="4"
            art_meta_y="8" stream_row="32"/>
  <geometry set="classic-light"/>
  <!-- every scheme: white text on the band in both halves; a row's second line #949294, which the light half
       flips onto #6b6d6b; the light half on white paper, black ink; the status bar's gloss over
       its 1 px line, and the light half's second line above that; the dark half's bar is flat over a hairline -->
  <colorScheme sel.text="#ffffff" muted="#949294" light.paper="#ffffff" light.ink="#000000" light.sel.text="#ffffff"
               light.bar.stops="#ffffff 0, #e7e7e7 26, #cecbce 53, #adaaad 79, #9c9e9c 100" light.bar.line="#5a595a" bar.line2="#848584"
               dark.bar.stops="#1c1c1c 0, #1c1c1c 100" dark.bar.line="#333333"/>
  <!-- Classic Blue: Cobalt's tones and its own band: its 1 px top line, the stops below it, its edge, and a tall
       row's second and last lines. The light lines are the light half's: on black the band starts on its first stop
       and ends on its dark edge. The other accents get this band turned to their own top tone -->
  <colorScheme name="classic-blue" label="Classic Blue" base="cobalt" light.sel.top="#94c7de" dark.sel.top="#08a6e7"
               sel.stops="#08a6e7 0, #009ade 17, #008ade 38, #007dde 58, #006dd6 79, #0065d6 100"
               sel.edge="#004184" sel.tall_edge="#004aa3" light.sel.tall_line="#688db3" dark.sel.tall_line="#004aa3" light.sel.tall_top="#27ade5" dark.sel.tall_top="#08a6e7"/>
  <colorSchemes accents="classic-blue graphite crimson tidal champagne cobalt tangerine plum green" derive="gloss"/>
  <!-- Classic's face: list rows (title 27 px, 28 on a two-line row, second line 17 px in stock's regular face), the bar title and clock (21 px, stated again as the set's bar_px: three quarters of a row's caps, an iPod's bar to its rows), the Now Playing title and Home rows (27 px); the bar's fill is the scheme's gloss; the white chevron on the selected row only, tools/art.py's 12 x 16 drawing, centred on the row at these x. The classic-light battery: a grey
       outline and a gloss green level, a hue in both halves -->
  <view name="list">
    <element name="selection" painter="stops"/>
    <element name="icons" mono="0" badge_muted="0" addon_mono="0" badge_ink="1"/>
    <element name="row" font="classic-light" title_px="27" meta_px="17" text_end="350" tall_font="classic-light" tall_px="28"/>
    <!-- Songs' rows and Play All's end on these three rows, each row its stop; none on the selected row -->
    <element name="separator" light.stops="#fcfcfc 0, #e2e3e2 50, #f7f7f7 100" dark.stops="#000000 0, #2c2c2c 50, #000000 100"/>
    <!-- Albums' and the other 52 px rows: the cover, drawn square, then two lines of text; it clears the glass at the row under the bar by 1 px -->
    <element name="art" x="22" text_x="82" text_end="310" placeholder="38"/>
    <element name="chevron" selected="1" x="317"/>
    <!-- The fast-scroll letter, the same in both halves -->
    <element name="letter" raw="1" px="60"/>
    <!-- A list that scrolls keeps a thin thumb at its right edge, over the rows, with no track; its ends stay clear
         of the glass -->
    <element name="scrollbar" w="4" right="2" top="59" bottom="261" min="16" light.thumb="#8f98a8" dark.thumb="#6e7380"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Cover Flow's shelf: the side covers stand where Minimal's do (#329's iPod preset), unshaded out to the third;
       the reflections go under the caption, so the frame is taller than the other themes'. The thumb's numbers are
       Minimal's, every theme's. -->
  <view name="coverflow">
    <element name="shelf" top="32" third="1" bright1="256" bright2="256" reflect="46" reflect_top="90" view_h="242"/>
    <!-- The album and the artist in the title's face, 24 px apart: their boxes overlap, as each must hold the font -->
    <element name="caption" name_px="27" artist_px="27" text_y="220" artist_y="26"/>
    <!-- The landing: a song picked on the flip panel flies its cover to Now Playing. No press, it plays at once;
         400 ms in all over 55% of the way, the panel fading out from 0 for 110 ms and Now Playing in from 90 ms for
         100, the landed art held 2000 ms at most for Now Playing's own. ms 0: none. -->
    <element name="land" press="0" ms="400" travel="55" out_at="0" out_ms="110" np_at="90" np_ms="100" hold="2000"/>
  </view>
  <view name="bar">
    <element name="title" font="classic-light" font_size="21" caps="0"/>
    <element name="fill" painter="gloss"/>
    <!-- The battery's inside: its stops mixed over the rows, the bright one at y 8, the dark rows past the level, a red sliver
         when low; its edges and the white that sits under it on the light half's gloss. Alphas of 255. The bolt
         (charging) and the plug (full on power): colour and the bolt's white halo, tools/art.py draws them. -->
    <element name="battery" painter="classic-light" light.line="#717070" dark.line="#717070" edge="#5b6c52"
             stops="#90b27d 0, #c4ebac 8, #dcf9c5 17, #cbefb1 25, #ade586 33, #a6e27b 42, #92ce68 50, #67a83f 58, #4e972c 67, #4e972d 75, #56a035 83, #58a437 92, #539933 100"
             empty="#56585d 0, #595a61 8, #5f6168 17, #63656c 25, #6b6d73 33, #76787e 42, #85878d 50, #898b92 58, #8d8f96 67, #94969c 75, #9ea0a5 83, #a0a3a6 92, #797b7c 100"
             low="#d9402e" low_w="3" corner_a="191" foot_a="128" shade_a="64" soft_a="51" soft_top_a="28" emboss_a="179" emboss_nub_a="153" bolt="#3c4a34" bolt_halo_a="102"/>
    <element name="icons" bt_dy="1" wifi_dy="-1"/>
    <!-- The play state's fill and 1 px edge, top to bottom, with no halo (an iPod's has none); tools/art.py draws
         the triangle and the bars. -->
    <element name="state" stops="#0f4f93 0, #1a76b3 20, #2ea8e1 33, #39c7f8 47, #38c7f5 53, #32b1e9 60, #2699d7 67, #2085c3 73, #1c73b1 80, #1666a5 87, #135999 100"
             edge="#114c8f 0, #135999 100" halo_light="0" halo_dark="0"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Now Playing, an iPod classic's: the art turned in perspective over its reflection (the classic-light sets' np_ipod,
       coverflow.c slant_render), and the progress bar's track over its NP_BAR_IPOD (20) rows: faint 1 px top
       and bottom lines round a near-white inside, the inner stops from 5 to 95 so no row past the first and before the
       last takes an edge's colour; the dark half's Apple's capture darkened, its step at the middle
       kept; a column at each end in the last stop's colour (np_bar.c ipod_bar). The played part is the accent's band;
       under Classic Blue it is fill: the 14 rows of the bar in Apple's native 320x240 capture (iPod classic User
       Guide, Now Playing), its two nearly equal rows at 27 made one to fit 13 stops. Its rows painter's 31 rows, fixed
       colours (#rrggbbaa its own alpha), are the volume panel's away from Now Playing and a card app's progress -->
  <view name="playing">
    <element name="art" square="1"/>
    <element name="scrubber" fill="#7d96d7 0, #86aafe 8, #739df9 15, #6b9bf2 27, #6ca2f8 38, #65a3ff 46, #3c89eb 54, #3698f8 62, #32a2fe 69, #36affe 77, #40b3fc 85, #5bbbfe 92, #5b9ecf 100"
             light.stops="#e2e2e2 0, #ffffff 5, #ffffff 14, #ffffff 23, #fafafa 32, #fafafa 41, #f6f6f6 50, #f6f6f6 59, #f6f6f6 68, #f4f4f4 77, #f4f4f4 86, #f4f4f4 95, #cecece 100"
             dark.stops="#313131 0, #373737 5, #383838 14, #373737 23, #363636 32, #353535 41, #323232 50, #313131 59, #323232 68, #343434 77, #353535 86, #343434 95, #2b2b2b 100"
             painter="rows"
             light_track="#e7e7e7 #eeeeee #ffffff #fdfdfd #f7f7f7 #f7f7f7 #f3f3f3 #f0f0f0 #ebebeb #e4e4e4 #dedede #dfdfdf #e6e6e6 #ededed #ececec #d1d1d1 #d0d0d0 #fdfdfd #f0f0f0 #efefef #f5f5f5 #f8f8f8 #f4f4f4 #efefef #efefef #efefef #f6f6f6 #f7f7f7 #f7f7f7 #f7f7f7 #f9f9f9"
             light_fill="#99afde #87abe9 #72a3e6 #74a6ed #74a6ed #78a2ee #77a6f4 #69aafa #4c9ef0 #3d9df3 #46b1ff #42b8ff #4fc7ff #4fc7ff #57caf6 #50b1d1 #95d5ee #c7f2ff #c7f2ff #ceefff #d2ecfd #d2ecfd #daedfe #deeefe #deeefe #e7f1fd #eef5ff #eef5ff #f8f9fe #fcfcfe #fcfcfe"
             dark_track="#4e4d4e #585758 #555455 #515151 #4e4e4e #4b4a4b #474747 #444444 #424242 #434343 #444444 #454445 #454545 #464546 #474647 #484748 #383838 #42414256 #42414250 #42414249 #42414243 #4241423d #42414236 #42414230 #42414229 #42414223 #4241421d #42414216 #42414210 #4241420a #42414203"
             dark_fill="#99afde #87abe9 #72a3e6 #74a6ed #74a6ed #78a2ee #77a6f4 #69aafa #4c9ef0 #3d9df3 #46b1ff #42b8ff #4fc7ff #4fc7ff #57caf6 #50b1d1 #95d5ee #46b1ff4f #46b1ff49 #46b1ff43 #46b1ff3d #46b1ff37 #46b1ff32 #46b1ff2c #46b1ff26 #46b1ff20 #46b1ff1a #46b1ff14 #46b1ff0f #46b1ff09 #46b1ff03"/>
    <element name="title" font="classic-light" font_px="27"/>
    <element name="album" caps="0" opacity="255"/>
    <element name="state" opacity="0"/>  <!-- no play/pause glyph on the art, as Minimal -->
    <!-- The theme's face at a small size: the QR pages', the Time Zone caption, page notes, and Now Playing's info rows,
         their names in the ink and their values in this grey, final in each half -->
    <element name="info" font="classic-light" font_size="17" light.value="#8e9196" dark.value="#8a8a8a"/>
    <!-- Internet Radio's cover under the slanted art (tools/art.py station): a slate gradient, a light band, a white mast -->
    <element name="station" stops="#94a2a5 0, #6b7584 100" mast="#ffffff 0, #f3f5f8 45, #c0c8ca 100" band_a="13" shadow_a="85"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Home's rows: the text 20 px in, the white chevron. Where no cover shows, Split's pane: one flat colour (no light
       across it, no shadow down its left edge), slate on paper, and on black the dark bar's #1c1c1c, the note (note.svg, at note_x, note_y in the pane) and the queue's count in white,
       centred on the pane's first count_w columns, its 24 px line box at count_y. The pane follows the highlighted row:
       a row's icon (tools/art.py) at icon_x, icon_y, its caption where the count is; on Streaming's list the service's icon, svc_px square at svc_x, svc_y. Its colour is stated at 0 and 100,
       as a stops list must end at 100. Its first stop also fills Classic's own full-screen pages (navigation.c paint_page) -->
  <view name="home">
    <element name="rows" top="0" text_x="20" font="classic-light" font_px="27" full_row="375" label_end_split="20" label_end_full="33" caps="0"/>
    <element name="chevron" visible="1" x="168"/>
    <element name="pane" light.stops="#63717b 0, #63717b 100" dark.stops="#1c1c1c 0, #1c1c1c 100" light_a="0" shadow="#000000" shadow_w="0"
             shadow_a="116 100 93 86 79 73 68 62 56 50 44 39 34 28 24 19 16 13 10 8 6 4 3 2 1"
             icon_x="43" icon_y="67" note_x="40" note_y="57" count_y="185" count_w="182" count_px="27" svc_x="46" svc_y="62" svc_px="96"/>
  </view>
  <!-- page_list's rows (the Library's Shuffle, Most Played, Era, card apps...): 32 px, or Songs' two lines at 52 with a
       detail, their boxes holding the fonts and centring them where Songs' do; the bar holds the title, so no title row -->
  <view name="page">
    <element name="rows" height="32" detail_height="52" text_x="20" title_y="-1" title_h="28" detail_y="28" detail_h="18"/>
    <element name="title" height="0"/>
  </view>
  <!-- a settings row is its title with the value right-aligned -->
  <view name="settings"><element name="values" text="1"/></view>
  <view name="volume"><element name="panel" painter="classic-light"/></view>
  <!-- The confirm control's two forms, the hold menu over the page, the toast and small dialogs -->
  <view name="dialog"><element name="confirm" painter="classic-light"/></view>
  <!-- Its own pages: Quick Settings, the slider pages, the rating, T9 and Search, Set Time and Date, the message
       screens, the lock info screen, Cover Flow's flip -->
  <view name="pages"><element name="own" painter="classic-light" art_final="1"/></view>
  <option key="STATUSBAR" label="Status Bar" default="Theme" preset="Theme"><value label="Theme"/><value label="Minimal"/><value label="Modern"/><value label="Classic"/></option>
  <option setting="time_title" preset="on"/>
  <option key="SHOWQ2POD" label="Show Wordmark" default="On"><value label="Off"/><value label="On"/></option>
  <!-- Light Mode: On is the look as drawn, Off its dark half, Auto both by the clock -->
  <option setting="light" preset="on" keep="auto"/>
  <option setting="accent" key="CLASSIC_LIGHT_ACCENT" default="classic-blue" preset="classic-blue"/>
  <option setting="home" preset="split"/>
  <option setting="shortcut"/>
  <!-- Battery: the plain icon, chosen with Classic, the percent alone, or Percent Inside. default is what a stored
       Icon + Percent reads as; the key itself stays as stored until the row is cycled. -->
  <option setting="battery" values="icon percent inside" default="inside"/>
  <!-- Row Art, Classic's own option: it decides album covers. On shows them in 52 px rows in Albums and the other
       art lists (the classic-light set), Off makes those lists 32 px text (classic-light-text). The Library is text either way.
       A change restarts the Q2. Choosing Classic presets On. -->
  <!-- Classic's Home in Split, each its own switch, on as chosen, as Classic presets its own: Library on Home slides
       the Library's rows in on Home (off, Library opens its page), Row Preview has the pane follow the highlighted row
       (off, it shows Now Playing's art on every row) -->
  <option key="HOMELIB" label="Library on Home" default="On" preset="On"><value label="Off"/><value label="On"/></option>
  <option key="ROWPREVIEW" label="Row Preview" default="On" preset="On"><value label="Off"/><value label="On"/></option>
  <option key="ROWART" label="Row Art" default="On" preset="On">
    <value label="Off" set="classic-light-text"/>
    <value label="On" set="classic-light"/>
  </option>
  <!-- How things move. A window kind with no ms keeps its asset's hint, or none: pages open as Minimal's do. The selection jumps, with no glide and no bump. Cover Flow's step follows its goal: under easing="follow",
       ms is the follow's time constant, not the run's length. -->
  <view name="motion">
    <element name="page" ms="120" easing="cubic_out"/>
    <element name="swap" ms="120" easing="linear"/>
    <element name="inplace" ms="120" easing="cubic_out"/>
    <element name="step" ms="200" easing="sin_inout"/>
    <element name="step_fast" ms="120" easing="sin_inout"/>
    <element name="coverflow_step" ms="81" easing="follow"/>
    <element name="coverflow_step_fast" ms="81" easing="follow"/>
    <element name="recall" ms="0"/>
    <element name="bump" px="0"/>
  </view>
</theme>

themes.text:
<!-- Theme: Modern (IPOD/THEME 2, docs/ipod.md#display-settings): the accent's bar over Minimal's layout. Its numbers (Home rows, the settings top, the progress bar, the scheme
     colours) come from patch/offsets.inc via tools/theme.py ROLE_MACROS. -->
<theme format="1" id="modern" name="Modern" index="2" extends="minimal">
  <colorSchemes accents="graphite crimson tidal champagne cobalt tangerine plum green"/>
  <option key="STATUSBAR" label="Status Bar" default="Theme" preset="Theme"><value label="Theme"/><value label="Minimal"/><value label="Modern"/><value label="Classic"/></option>
  <option setting="time_title" preset="off"/>
  <option key="SHOWQ2POD" label="Show Wordmark" default="On"><value label="Off"/><value label="On"/></option>
  <option setting="light" preset="on" keep="auto"/>
  <option setting="accent" key="ACCENT" default="graphite" preset="cobalt"/>
  <option setting="corners" preset="square"/>
  <option setting="home" preset="split"/>
  <option setting="shortcut"/>
  <option setting="battery"/>
  <option setting="np_layout"/>
  <view name="bar"><element name="title" caps="0"/></view>
  <view name="list">
    <element name="selection" painter="bar"/>
    <element name="icons" mono="0" badge_muted="0" addon_mono="0"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Where no cover shows, Split's pane in the flat look: one flat colour, the flat pages' pale grey on paper and
       #1c1c1c on black, the note (tools/art.py's flat pane_note, at note_x, note_y) and the queue's count, quiet in the
       system's face at count_px, centred on the pane's first count_w columns at count_y. It stays Now Playing's on every
       row (icon_x 0) -->
  <view name="home">
    <element name="chevron" visible="1"/><element name="rows" caps="0"/>
    <element name="pane" light.stops="#f2f2f7 0, #f2f2f7 100" dark.stops="#1c1c1c 0, #1c1c1c 100" light_a="0" shadow_w="0"
             icon_x="0" note_x="40" note_y="57" count_y="185" count_w="182" count_px="17"/>
  </view>
  <view name="playing">
    <element name="art" square="1"/>
    <element name="title" font="bold"/>
    <element name="album" caps="0" opacity="255"/>
    <element name="state" opacity="255"/>
  </view>
  <!-- Its own pages and prompts in the flat look (patch/flat.c): Quick Settings, the slider pages, the message screens,
       Set Date and Set Time, the confirm, the volume's panel; the others stay stock's -->
  <view name="pages"><element name="own" painter="flat" art_final="1"/></view>
  <view name="dialog"><element name="confirm" painter="flat"/></view>
  <view name="volume"><element name="panel" painter="flat"/></view>
</theme>

themes.text:
<!-- Theme: Classic Modern (IPOD/THEME 3, docs/ipod.md#display-settings): Classic in everything, on its sets and
     options (a switch between the two is live), but for the flat look's screens (patch/flat.c) over Classic's
     own pages: Quick Settings, the slider pages, the message screens, Set Date and Set Time, the confirm
     prompts and the hold menu, Now Playing's marks, the flat volume panel and Home's flat pane. Over Classic's own
     pages the flat look takes Classic's face and its lit tiles' colour. -->
<theme format="1" id="classic-modern" name="Classic Modern" index="3" extends="classic-light">
  <!-- Quick Settings' cards on a pale grey in the light half, Set Date's fields 6 px apart; the lock screen's info page
       keeps Classic's pane colours -->
  <view name="pages">
    <element name="own" painter="classic-light+flat" light.fill="#63717b" dark.fill="#1c1c1c"/>
    <element name="quick" light_ground="#f2f2f7"/>
    <element name="date" gap="6"/>
  </view>
  <view name="dialog"><element name="confirm" painter="classic-light+flat"/></view>
  <view name="volume"><element name="panel" painter="flat"/></view>
  <!-- Split's pane where no cover shows: the flat pages' pale grey on paper, each row's flat icon in the half's ink
       (coverflow.c pane_art) and the caption quiet in the system's face -->
  <view name="home"><element name="pane" light.stops="#f2f2f7 0, #f2f2f7 100" count_px="17"/></view>
</theme>
